title: Shinonome Ena — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ena's birthday
Outside Shibuya Station

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's Ena's birthday today!
And that means...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's time for the Photogenic Birthday Girl Tour!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As the name implies, we'll be escorting our birthday girl to a number of picturesque spots so she can take the perfect selfies!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
Although you make me sound like some sort of selfie snob...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I am not!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, are you hearing this, Airi? Sounds like someone does not approve of our special tour.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right... That's too bad. If she's not interested, we might as well call it quits...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, that's not what I said! It's not like I'm not interested...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Urgh. So this is why Mizuki was in such high spirits yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey everyone, tomorrow's Ena's birthday♪ That means tonight's the night we party it up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A birthday celebration? Sounds fun...
I'll let Luka and the others know.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Will you be able to make it, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Only for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's celebrate with Miku and the others in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you also planning to do something over there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Surprisingly, Ena actually has a ton of friends. We're getting together to put on a little celebration for her♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, make sure you're at the station tomorrow morning, Ena. Can't have the birthday girl being late, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I know already.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have fun, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I will. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, speaking of which, you mentioned something about getting together with others, but is it just us three?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If so, you could've also invited Shizuku...or was she busy?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh... It's funny you should mention her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What are you smiling for?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, you'll find out later. Anyway, it's time to visit our first photo spot!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! Alright Ena, let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, wait!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is our first stop: Vivid Street!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, this is where Akito works.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, isn't this a popular street for selfies? I've seen this area pop up a lot in magazines.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I had a hunch you'd be familiar with it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And now it's time for photos! Let's take one by that graffiti over there!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about a full-body picture like the ones in magazines?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You'll take one? Then, yes please.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oooh, Airi, you're great at this! Hey Ena, she's really captured your good side!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, lemme see!
We should rearrange the set list for the event. How about we throw in that track Toya made?
Good idea! More people definitely need to hear it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Urgh.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Li'l Bro and the others!
Yo!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, Akiyama, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey there! Akito, Toya, it's been a while, hasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ena told me you planned something for her. Thanks for making the time for this one despite your busy schedules.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What did you just call me? Now that's just rude!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
She's right, Akito.
Happy birthday, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you! I'm glad Akito actually managed to make some decent friends.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Break it off. As much as I'd love to watch you guys taking shots at each other, we have another photo spot to be getting to.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. This isn't the only place we'll be visiting on the tour...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please excuse us for interrupting.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys go have fun together!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks! Bye then!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That said, we are gonna be splitting up now♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? But why?
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ena, Ichika, Honami!!!
Welcome to Phoenix Wonderland♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today, I'll be showing you the prettiest, most wonderhoy spots the park has to offer!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll have a great time, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah! Lead the way!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Although Airi mentioned something about there being more to the tour than just that street, I didn't expect PXL to be part of it.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, judging by the looks they had on their faces, they've still got something else up their sleeves.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay then, we'll see you later♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So to recap, all you have to do is head to PXL. Your next guides will meet you there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They did say that they'd see me later. Does that mean they'll come meet up with us after this?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ena! It's time to head to our first photo spot☆

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: First up is...the adorable cat ear spot♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Cat ear spot?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. If you line yourself up between that restaurant and shop so the rooftops are above your head, then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, you're right. The rooftops look like cat ears! How adorable!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It might be tricky to get the angle and position just right, but let's all try.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-daa☆ Here's the next photo spot, which you can only enjoy this season—the hidden Phenny in the flowerbed♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, the flowers are growing in the shape of Phenny! It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Next up is this Phenny roller coaster.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you jump when the roller coaster passes by, we should be able to get a fun picture of you in the air next to it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Here it comes now! Aaand jump!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did you get it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it looks great!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Now let's all take one together! Poochie, could you please take our picture for us?☆

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Poochie!
Wait, where'd he come from?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ena! The next car is almost here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, hold on!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ahhh...now that was a lot of pictures.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It hasn't been long since I was last here, but I had no idea there were this many good photo spots.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm glad you had fun♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it's almost time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ena, we'll take you to the final spot of the tour now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The final spot?
